//: Cloakroom TRANSPARENT profile for Claude Code. The 'magic' mode.
//1: PostToolUse sanitizes Read/Bash/Grep/MCP-tool output into decoys BEFORE the model sees it;
//2: PreToolUse restores real values before a Write/Edit hits disk.
//3: Do NOT combine with the guard profile (guard would deny the read the sanitizer wants).
//4: Requires env in the shell that launches Claude Code:
//9: timeout 30 (seconds) sits above cloak's own 20s --deadline, so cloak fails closed first; Claude Code lets the call through when a hook times out.
//7: Best for logs/diagnostics/config. Risky for editing source files (the model
//8: reasons over decoys; a reworded decoy breaks restore — reverseGaps warns, but scope with care).

PreToolUse.//: Add |Bash to also restore decoys inside shell commands (e.g. ssh to a decoyed IP). A restored command always asks for your approval, even in bypass mode, because a command can send the real values somewhere; in headless (-p) runs it is blocked.

SessionEnd.//: Deletes the cached session key (<bridge>.key) when the session ends. The encrypted bridge stays, so a resumed session keeps its decoys.
